text:
marta: Quick heads-up — customer X is launching a feature next Wednesday that will route heavy inference traffic to Dedicated pools in us-central1 + europe-west1. We need a coordinated quota push today.

raj: Can you list exact quota types and counts? GPU SKUs + external IPs?

marta: Sure — preliminary ask: 40 x A100-80GB (dedicated), 60 x A10G (burst/worker), 150 static external IPs across the two projects (50 eu, 100 us), and vCPU quota bump for 600 more vCPUs in both regions combined. Also raise forwarding-rule and global load balancer quotas if possible.

sylvia: Do we need regional PD SSD IOPS or disk quota increases too? Persistent disks for model weights might spike.

marta: Yes — add 50TB additional persistent disk capacity and 2,000 additional snapshots.

leon: Timeline? Are we planning to use preemptibles for the A10 pool? Cost/time tradeoff matters for the requested headroom.

marta: Plan: primary steady capacity on A100 reserved (the 40 committed), A10s as warm preemptible workers for burst. We want 20% headroom for autoscaler so the quota needs to permit instantaneous allocation.

raj: Ok — I'll draft quota tickets to GCP. For internal approvals: does Finance sign off on the reserved commit for A100 now or later?

marta: Finance approved up to $X/month for a short-term committed order if it's necessary to guarantee latency. Otherwise we fallback to spot/provision mix.

cloud-ops: @marta @raj I ran a quick simulation based on last-quarter traffic + projected 3x launch delta. If autoscaler target is 20% headroom we should request 1.4x the expected peak. Suggested ask: 56 A100 equivalents, 84 A10s, 180 external IPs, 750 vCPUs regionally.

sylvia: Also call out NAT gateway ephemeral address limits — we hit SNAT port exhaustion last month during a test. Need to request higher ephemeral ports or additional NATs per region.

infra-bot: Reminder: quota change requests take 48–72hrs for GCP quota team. Attach justification, expected start/end dates, and traffic simulation.

raj: Drafting ticket now. Using gcloud to pre-check current quotas: ```
# check gpu quotas in project
gcloud compute regions describe us-central1 --project=my-dedicated-project --format="json(quotas)"
```

raj: I'll paste the ticket text here for review before submission.

marta: Add note that models are pinned to different quantization profiles (fp16, int8) across pools so A100s hold larger weights — helps justify committed capacity.

leon: Also request a temporary exception for forwarding-rule limit for the launch window: we'll create per-region LB frontends for traffic isolation.

sylvia: For networking: request increase in subnetwork secondary IP ranges for pod IPs (GKE) — we saw runaway pod churn last trial.

raj: Submitted tickets: case #Q-39211 (us-central1), #Q-39212 (europe-west1). Included the simulation CSV and autoscaler policy snippet. GCP reply ETA ~ 60 hours.

marta: Thanks — can someone follow up with Sales/Customer Success to confirm launch cadence so we can roll back any unused commit?

cloud-ops: I'll own rollback plan. Also adding a monitoring alert to spike on dedicated pool fill > 75% so we can toggle burst behavior.

infra-bot: Deployment note: when quotas are approved, update terraform variables and run a dry-plan in staging: `terraform plan -var='gcp_region=us-central1'`

marta: Perfect. If anything comes back from GCP requesting clarification ping here immediately. :pray: 

leon: One more — include a cost comparison in the ticket: committed A100 vs mixed reserved + preemptible for 30-day window. Helps GCP prioritization.

raj: Will attach cost sheet. Closing loop for now — will post updates in this thread.

marta: Thanks team.
